slides.title: UN calls for an immediate ceasefire in Tigray
slides.body: UN Resident Coordinator Ozonnia Ojielo, Oct. 20

slides.title: “The fighting must stop”
slides.body: “...the looting must stop, the shooting must stop,” Ojielo said, as reported by The Reporter.

slides.title: “Tired of war”
slides.body: He said the people of Tigray “are tired of war and they want normalcy.”

slides.title: What the UN is asking for
slides.body: Return of civilian government, unhindered access for food, medicine and water, safe return of displaced people, and accountability for past abuses.

slides.title: Ceasefire. Aid access. Dialogue.
